steps.text: Train Mining until level 52. — The guide doesn't care how you train, but power-mining iron is pretty solid

steps.title: Obtain some Ice gloves from the …
steps.text: Obtain some Ice gloves from the Ice Queen. — Bring some casts of fire blast to kill her

steps.title: Clear out your inventory and gear. …
steps.text: Clear out your inventory and gear. You can sell or alch the rune pickaxe: — Wearing Ice gloves. — Wearing the Chronicle. — Coins in your inventory and nothing else

steps.title: Train Smithing at Giant's Foundry until …
steps.text: Train Smithing at Giant's Foundry until level 70+. — Method Link — You can switch to steel/mith at level 50, or stick to iron/steel to save money. — Consider staying until you can complete the Smiths' Uniform so that you can have the storable smiths gloves (i). You will need ice gloves later in the guide, and throughout the life of your account. — Still buy the moulds you can first, they make a big difference in your xp and gp. It is OK to stay here awhile as you need Smithing eventually for the Lumbridge Elite Diary. — Make sure you buy the Smiths tunic last, otherwise you'll have to go back to your house to store it. — At level 70, you can switch to adamant and mith platebodies if you would like. They can be purchased in the Varlamore shop.

steps.title: You will need: — 1800 Law …
steps.text: You will need: — 1800 Law runes — 500 Soul runes — 200 Minds runes — 500 Water runes — 400 Fire runes — 1400 Air runes — 700 Earth runes

steps.title: Create the following teleports in your …
steps.text: Create the following teleports in your house: — Salve Graveyard — Fenkenstrain's Castle — Battlefront — Arceuus Library — Draynor Manor — West Ardougne — Mind Altar — Varrock — Ardougne — Falador — Lumbridge — Camelot — Kourend — Civitas illa Fortis — (Optional) Watchtower. Runes not included in original numbers.

steps.title: Move your house to Hosidius. — …
steps.text: Move your house to Hosidius. — You can get to your house when you deathbank with the Tithe Farm minigame teleport. Then take the Battlefront teleport to the Farming Guild. — (Optional) Complete the The Forsaken Tower and for free minecart usage and you can use that to the Farming Guild instead.
